title: The bulk confirmation title and first line give the count
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts, part A and part B, and an inactive part, part C, for this test.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  7. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  8. Click the part B row.
  9. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  10. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  11. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
  12. Click the Inactive tab.
  13. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  14. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  15. Click Activate parts.
  16. Click the part C row.
  17. Click Activate on the dark bar.
  18. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 4:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 2 selected.

Step 6:

  • Before anything changes, a confirmation titled "Deactivate parts?" opens, whose first line reads "2 parts selected."

Step 7:

  • The confirmation closes and nothing changed.

Step 8:

  • Part B is unticked and the bar reads 1 selected.

Step 9:

  • The confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" and its first line reads "1 part selected."

Step 10:

  • The confirmation closes.

Step 11:

  • Bulk mode ends.

Step 12:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 13:

  • Part C is listed.

Step 14:

  • The menu opens.

Step 15:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 16:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 17:

  • The confirmation is titled "Activate parts?" and its first line reads "1 part selected."

Step 18:

  • The confirmation closes and no part changed status.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R1: “A status change is confirmed before it is applied, from either entry point: the bulk bar (Stories 2 and 3), or Save in the part dialog after the user picks a different Part Status (S13-R21).”
